message.content:
The market that consistently draws the biggest crowds in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the city’s largest open‑air farmers’ market, operating every Saturday from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. (and on select holidays). Over the years it has attracted hundreds of thousands of visitors each season, making it the most frequented market in the city.
